designationHistory.indexText: The Acting Secretary of Agriculture ordered that Weeks Act lands in the described areas of Ohio be administered as the Wayne National Forest from Oct. 1, 1951.

authority.citation: Order of the Secretary of Agriculture, Sept. 4, 1951 (effective Oct. 1, 1951), 16 F.R. 9174

designationHistory.note: Signed Sept. 4, 1951 by Acting Secretary K. T. Hutchinson; effective Oct. 1, 1951. Wayne was later administered jointly with the Hoosier (Wayne-Hoosier); that was administrative.
